framework: INVEST Criteria for Agile User Stories

criteria.Independent: User story should be self-contained and not tightly coupled to other stories.
criteria.Negotiable: User story is not an explicit contract; details are co-created with the team.
criteria.Valuable: User story delivers clear value to the end user (Role-Action-Benefit).
criteria.Estimable: Requirements must be concrete enough for developers to estimate effort.
criteria.Small: Story size should fit comfortably within one sprint iteration.
criteria.Testable: Must have clear, unambiguous Acceptance Criteria (Given-When-Then format).

pattern_check.user_story_format_en: As a [Role], I want to [Action], So that [Benefit]
